earlier_failed_multihead_observation.interpretation: native gather failure may leave a peer pending at teardown; concurrent issuance depends on transport timing
earlier_failed_multihead_observation.scope: recorded exploratory fixture observation; no universal failure-count parity claim

limits: score and summary complete modules only; partition fixture is declared input
synthetic transport judgments do not establish judge accuracy or semantic diversity
new cache inputs use new frozen invocations; dynamic checkpoint adoption is not implemented
raw receipt replay reuses one immutable owner and original inputs with fresh scratch
concurrent JSONL order may vary; IDs and row data are never changed for comparison
failed-parser fixtures use one head per row; arbitrary failed multihead issued-call counts are timing-dependent and are not claimed equal
